AI Tinkerers Talk and Demo Library

video_source_sweep.rule: Attempt discovery at every registered video source, including disabled qualification leads. Record actual source-specific results before selection lock. A plan is not evidence of an attempt; disabled leads remain unapproved for selection until independently qualified.

scientific_papers.selection_rule: Seek one genuinely qualifying original-paper-led story within every rolling seven editions. Record real methods, sample, limitations, venue and original paper link. Distinguish preprint from peer review. Never force an unqualified or stale paper, change 2/2/2, or bypass freshness/novelty/protected gates.
scientific_papers.evidence_caveat: Verified means reported in explicit edition receipts; neither source discovery nor this planner proves a published paper or independent peer-review status.

video_discovery_fallbacks.evidence: Microsoft Learn provides publisher-owned episode pages and chapters. This example documents discovery and carries no current-edition or playback qualification.

rule: Plan enabled editorial sources as before; prioritize qualified original scientific-paper leads when the seven-edition paper target is due or historical evidence is missing, without forcing publication. Separately account for every registered video lead, including disabled qualification-only leads. The video_source_sweep plan never proves retrieval; write and validate actual per-source attempts before new-edition selection lock. Disabled resources stay unqualified unless independently admitted.
